serial_waveform.signaling: differential / optical NRZ (PAM-4 at 64GFC), embedded-clock with receiver CDR.
serial_waveform.word_sync: Receiver aligns on the K28.5 comma / ordered-set boundary.

frame_waveform.structure: SOF ordered set -> 24-byte header -> payload (<=2112 B) -> 32-bit CRC -> EOF ordered set.
frame_waveform.delimiters: SOF/EOF are FC-1 ordered sets bounding each frame.
frame_waveform.idle: IDLE ordered sets fill the link between frames.

link_init_transition_trigger_waveform.OFFLINE_to_handshake: A not-operational port transmits OLS; the partner transmits NOS.
link_init_transition_trigger_waveform.to_LRR: Partner responds with LRR (Link Reset Response).
link_init_transition_trigger_waveform.to_ACTIVE: Both ends operational; exchange IDLEs; frames may flow.
link_init_transition_trigger_waveform.loop_LIP: FC-AL: LIP resets the loop and triggers AL_PA assignment.

general_timing_rule: Fibre Channel is embedded-clock: each direction self-clocks via receiver CDR; word synchronization aligns on the K28.5 comma. The unit interval is set by the negotiated GFC baud rate. FC-2 framing, credit accounting, and the login/exchange FSMs run in the controller clock domain decoupled from the line rate.

voltage_levels.modulation: NRZ (PAM-4 at 64GFC); differential copper or optical.
voltage_levels.termination: Controlled-impedance differential pair or optical transceiver.
